description: Small herb, 10–25 cm high; stems simple, glabrous erect curved at base. Leaves clustered just below the inflorescence; stipules ovate-auriculate, few mm; petioles distinct 5–20 mm; lamina lanceolate, 4–7 by 0.5–3 cm, at base tapering towards the petiole, apex acute; upper surface glabrous or nearly so, lower pale green, appressed hairy. Inflorescence racemose, terminal, 3–6 cm, with pubescent axis. Flowers subsessile; bracts caduceus. Sepals lanceolate, 4–6 mm, with glandular bristles, 1–2 mm. Petals pink or whitish, 7–9 mm, obovate, emarginated. Fruit ellipsoid, ca 3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Anisadenia saxatilis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 194. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree 10–30 m high, bark grey or whitish, smooth or rugose. Pulp spongy, white. Branchlets pubescent to glabrescent. Leaves acute to acuminate, usually with a pronounced tip, 6–10 mm long, base cuneate to acute, 7–11.5 by 2.5–5 cm, coriaceous, green, shining, glabrous above, glabrous below or with scattered hair along the margin and midrib; secondary nerves 12–18 pairs, prominent on both sides; petiole pubescent, 3–7 mm long. Inflorescence in fascicles, 4–6-flowered; peduncle pubescent, 3–5 mm long. Flowers greenish; pedicel pubescent, 5–10 mm long. Calyx-tube puberulous outside and inside, 3–4 mm long; calyx-lobes 3–4 by 2–3.5 mm, puberulous on both sides (calyx much enlarged after flowering). Petals densely pilose, 1–1.5 mm long. Stamens with filaments 1–1.5 mm long; anthers 1 mm long. Ovary puberulous, 2–3 mm long; style not distinct; stigma capitate to oblong, 1 mm long. Fruit suborbicular, puberulous, 2.5–3.5 by 2–2.5 cm, at the base surrounded by the persistent calyx, increasing in size after flowering; seeds 10 by 5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aquilaria crassna. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 228. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree to 14 m tall. Leaves acuminate, base cuneate to obtuse or rounded, 6.5–14 by 2.5–5.5 cm, subcoriaceous, lower surface densely pubescent esp. on the midrib, sometimes glabrescent; petiole pubescent, 5–7 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, 5–14 flowered; peduncle pubescent, 0–10 mm long. Flowers white or light yellow, pedicel up to 20 mm long. Calyx-tube cylincric, 6–8 mm long, densely pubescent outside; calyx-lobes ovate and obtuse, 2–3 mm long, densely pubescent outside and densely puberulous inside. Petals densely villous, ca 1 mm long. Stamens sessile, anthers ca 1 mm long. Ovary sessile, densely puberulous, 5 mm long; stigma capitate. Fruit (acc. to Ding Hou) oblanceolate. Seed ovoid, puberulous, glabrescent, shortly beaked at the apex, the glabrous appendage ca 10 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aquilaria hirta. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 230. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree up to 40 m tall, bark whitish to greyish, smooth; branchlets slender, pubescent glabrescent. Leaves acuminate, sometimes with a rather pronounced tip, 0.5–1 cm long, 5–15 cm by 2–5.2 cm, base cuneate, chartaceous, glabrous or with scattered hairs along the midrib beneath; secondary nerves 12–16 pairs, elevated beneath, obscure above; petiole pubescent or glabrous, 3–6 mm long. Inflorescence terminal or axillary, 8–10-flowered; peduncle pubescent to slightly hairy, 4–10 mm long. Flowers green or yellowish; pedicel slightly hairy, 2–5 mm long. Calyx-tube 3–5 mm long puberulous outside, almost glabrous inside; calyx-lobes 2–3 by 1.5–2 mm, puberulous on both sides. Petals pilose, 1–1.5 mm long. Stamens with filaments 1–2 mm long; anthers 1–1.5 mm long. Ovary pubescent, 1–2 mm long; style not distinct; stigma globose, 1 mm. Fruit oblong, 2.5–4 by 1.5–2.5 cm (unripe), pubescent. Seed ovoid, 10 by 6 mm, covered with red hairs, beak ca 4 mm long, appendage twisted, as long as the seed.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aquilaria malaccensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 227. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrubs or small trees up to 2 m tall. Leaves acuminate, base cuneate to obtuse, (14–)19–27.5 by (5–)7–10.5 cm, chartaceous, lower surface slightly pubescent to glabrescent; petiole pubescent or glabrous, 5–10 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, 8–20-flowered; peduncle puberulous, 1–3 cm long. Flowers white; pedicel puberulous, 6–13 mm long. Calyx-tube 5–12 mm long, outside slightly puberulous or glabrous, inside hairy towards base; calyx-lobes 3–5 by 1.2–2.5 mm, ± puberulous on the upper half inside, sparsely hairy or glabrous outside, ciliated. Petals united at the base, erose, villous, 1–1.5 mm long. Stamens sessile; anthers 1.5–2 mm long. Ovary sessile, puberulous, 2–3 mm long; style 0.5–1 mm long; stigma globose, 1 mm. Fruit elliptic; seed narrowly elliptic, sparsely puberulous, the glabrous appenage attached along one side of the elongate part.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aquilaria subintegra. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 230. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Slender annual (? or perennial) herb. Stems ascending to 20 cm, glabrous or with scattered simple hairs especially at stem base. Leaves few, simple or rarely with 1–2 small basal lobes, thin-textured, ± ovate-orbicular in outline, subentire to crenate; basal leaves ca 4–6 by 3 cm with a ca 8 mm petiole. Racemes short, lax, ca 5–10-flowered. Petals white, ca 3 mm. Fruiting pedicels ascending-erect, ca 7 mm. Siliqua ± erect, ca 25 by 0.9 mm; valves brownish-green. Seeds ca 1 by 0.5 mm, apically finely winged.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Cardamine circaeoides. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 181. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual. Stems ± slender, often branched from the base, with erect or ascending branches to ca 50 cm but usually less, glabrous or with scattered simple hairs more numerous at stem base. Leaves pinnate, the basal ones forming a rosette; segments ± ovate, crenate or lobed. Petals ca 3 by 1.5 mm, scarcely exceeding the sepals, rarely absent. Fruiting pedicels erect-spreading, 3.5–7 mm. Siliqua ± erect, over-topping the flowers, ca 15–20 by 0.9 mm; style 0–0.5 mm. Seeds 0.9 by 0.5 mm, broad oblong, brown with a minute wing at apex, smooth.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Cardamine hirsuta. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 180. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub or small tree up to 4 m high. Leaves narrowly elliptic to elliptic, gradually narrowed at both ends, (3–)6–12(–15) by 1.5–4.5 cm, herbaceous to thinly coriaceous, glabrous, glaucous beneath; nerves distinct below, obscure above; petiole 2–5 mm long. Inflorescence axillary heads with two green, often red-tinged involucral, caducous bracts, broadly ovate, 8–10 mm by 10–12 mm, minutely pubescent especially towards the top; peduncle slender, 2–5 cm long, glabrous, slightly pilose at top, often nodding; at the base with 2–4 bracteoles, 2–2.5 by 0.5–1 mm wide, slightly pilose. Flowers 6–14, pale yellow or white, sessile. Calyx-tube 6–11 mm long, yellowish or sericeous pilose outside, scented; calyx-lobes ovate, 2.5–4 by 1.2–3 mm. Stamens included or the upper slightly exserted; filaments ca 0.5 mm long; anthers 1.2 mm long. Ovary 1.5–2 mm long, densely pilose at the top; style 1–2.5 mm long; stigma globose, usually inclined; disc often lobed, 0.5–2 mm. Fruit 8–12 by 5 mm, black or black-purple.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Daphne composita. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 243. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub up to 3.5 m high; branches erect, young ones glabrous or hairy. Leaves narrowly elliptic to ovate-elliptic, acute to acuminate at both ends, (6–)9–14(–19) by 1.9–4.6 cm wide, light green, shining, thinly coriaceous, glabrous; petiole 5–10 mm long. Inflorescence terminal clusters, often also on side branches; bracts early deciduous; peduncle to 5 mm long, hirsute. Flowers 5–14, white or cream-coloured; pedicel 1–2 mm long. Calyx-tube 10–15 mm long, pubescent outside, fragrant; calyx-lobes narrowly ovate, acute to acuminate, 5–8 by 2–4 mm, ± pubescent. Stamens sub-sessile, anthers 1–2 mm long. Ovary ± 3 mm long, glabrous; style ± 2 mm long; disc slightly crenulated, 0.8–1.2 mm. Fruit 8–11 by 5 mm, orange-red.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Daphne sureil. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 244. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Erect shrubs with thick rootstock up to 1 m or trees growing to 5 m; branches pubescent to glabrescent. Leaves subopposite to alternate, elliptic, apex obtuse, mucronate, base cuneate, coriaceous, upper side glabrous or slightly hairy at the base, lower side greyish or reddish pubescent especially along midrib and lateral veins, glabrescent, 2.5–4.5 by 1–2 cm, lateral veins 15–22 pairs; petioles pubescent or glabrous, 2–5 mm long. Inflorescence at the top of the young branches, paniculiform, 6–18-flowered; peduncle 2–5 cm long; bracts below the middle of the peduncle, up to 35 mm long and 20 mm wide, reddish pubescent on both sides. Flowers white. Calyx tube 6–12 mm long; calyx-lobes 3.5–5 by 1.5–2 mm. Petals 3–5 mm long. Stamens with filaments up to 0.5 mm long; anthers 1–1.5 mm long. Ovary fusiform, slightly sericeous at top, 2–2.5 mm long; style 1–1.5 mm long; stigma clavate. Fruit slightly puberulent at the top, 14 by 6 mm. Seed 7 by 4 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Enkleia thorelii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 234. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub or climber, usually epiphytic, bark reddish-brown, slash-mark yellow turning deep orange; twigs when young often reddish-black, older reddish-brown, terete. Leaves: petiole 1–2.5 cm, terete, dark brownish-red to black, without auricles; lamina sub-orbicular to oblong to obovate, rarely oblanceolate, 8–17 by 3.5–8 cm; base acute; apex obtuse to rounded with a slender acumen to 2 cm; thickly coriaceous; reddish-brown colour when dry, darker on upper surface; main vein raised to sunken above, stoutly rounded below; secondary veins ± invisible on both surfaces. Stipules 1–1.5 mm high in leaf axils. Inflorescence terminal, 3–6(–8) flowered; peduncle absent pedicels subsessile to 7 mm. Calyx 1–1.5 cm, urceolate to campanulate; lobes 6–10 mm long. Corolla 5.4–6.6 cm, pale orange or salmon-coloured; tube 3.2–4 mm, cylindrical in bottom half, narrowly funnel-shaped above; lobes 2–2.6 cm, oblong. Stamens not exserted beyond corolla lobes; filaments 2.6–3.2 cm, anthers 4.5–5 mm, oblong to slightly ovate. Ovary and style 5.1–6.2 cm; stigma 1.5–2 mm, obconical. Fruits 2–3 by 1.5 cm, ellipsoid, green. Seeds 2–2.5 mm, ellipsoid to ovoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Fagraea acuminatissima. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 202. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree, shrub or climber; epiphytic or more rarely free standing; bark yellowish-brown, slash-mark pale yellow; twigs yellowish-brown, usually 4–6 angled or distinctly winged. Leaves: petiole absent or to 3.5 cm, 3–4 angled with a pair of poorly to well developed “auricles” at base; lamina obovate to oblanceolate or rarely elliptic, 9–35 by 3–12 cm; base cuneate; apex acuminate or obtuse with a short acumen; thickly coriaceous; main vein raised above, keeled to rounded below; secondary veins 5–11 pairs, invisible or visible above, visible below. Stipules: 2–7 mm high in leaf axils. Inflorescence terminal, 1–3(–7) flowered; peduncle absent; pedicels 1–3.5 cm long, stout. Calyx 3–4.7 cm, campanulate; lobes 2–4 cm, often spreading. Corolla 15–20 cm, creamy white, fleshy (almost woody when dry); tube 9–13 cm, funnel-shaped and often cylindrical at base; lobes 5.5–8 cm, oblong to obovate. Stamens slightly exserted, but not beyond corolla lobes, filaments 7.5–11 cm and 2 mm thick; anthers 1.6–2.3 cm, oblong. Ovary and style 14.0–16.5 cm; stigma 0.8–1 cm across, peltate. Fruit whitish green when ripe with outer translucent coat covering a sticky liquid layer; up to 15 by 6 cm when fresh (shrinking greatly on drying); oblong ovoid. Seeds 2–3.5 mm, ellipsoid to ovoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Fagraea auriculata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 204. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub or climber; epiphytic; bark greyish; twigs greyish-yellow, striate to angled. Leaves: petiole 1–3 cm, compressed, without auricles, though upper part clasping the stem; lamina ovate to obovate, 8–16 by 4–8 cm; base cuneate; apex acute, rounded or emarginate (in the latter cases minutely pointed); thickly coriaceous; secondary veins not clearly visible. Stipules: 0.5–0.75 cm high in leaf axils. Inflorescence: pedicels 1–2 cm, thick. Calyx 2–5 cm; lobes ca 1–2.5 cm long. Corolla yellowish-white; tube 7–14 cm, slender and tubular, slightly narrower at the base; lobes 3–3.5 cm. Stamens ; anthers 0.8–2 cm, oblong. Fruit 4–7 by 2–4 cm, ellipsoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Fagraea carnosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 204. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Liane, shrub or tree to 20 m, bark greyish, not fissured, slash-mark white; twigs grey, subterete. Leaves petiole 1–3.5 cm; lamina very variable in shape, usually (oblanceolate-) narrowly obovate to obovate, also elliptic or oblong, rarely ovate, 3.5–25 by 1.8–11.5 cm; base cuneate; apex rounded to acute, acuminate; coriaceous; midrib flat or barely raised above, prominently rounded to keeled below, secondary veins 4–7 pairs, barely visible to invisible above and below. Stipules 1–2 mm high in leaf axils. Inflorescence terminal, to 10 cm, 3–9(–12)-flowered, lax to dense; peduncle 0–5 cm; pedicels 0.8–4.5 cm. Calyx 0.9–2.7 cm high, campanulate to barely urceolate; lobes 5–12 mm, rounded to oblong. Corolla 4.2–8 cm, white to pale yellow; tube 3.3–4.5 mm, wide to narrowly funnel-shaped; lobes 1.8–3.5 cm, narrowly obovate to oblong. Stamens exserted, but not beyond corolla lobes, filaments 2.2–3.5 cm; anthers 6–10 mm, narrowly oblong to ovate. Ovary and style 4–6 cm; stigma 1.3–4 mm, obconical to peltate. Fruit green with a thin translucent coat covering a sticky layer, to 4.5 cm diam., globose. Seeds 2.5–3 mm, oblong-ellipsoid to ovoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Fagraea ceilanica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 201. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree; trunk and branches spiny. Leaves: petiole absent or very short with broad, recurved or amplexicaul auricles; lamina obovate, 18–45 by 14–25 cm; base narrowed; apex broadly rounded to truncate; midrib raised above and underneath; secondary veins clearly visible; margin clearly crenulate. Stipules: 1–1.5 cm high in leaf axils. Inflorescence many flowered and spreading; pedicels 1–2 cm. Calyx 1 cm; lobes ca 7 mm long. Corolla: tube 2 cm, cylindrical in bottom half, funnel-shaped above; lobes 1–1.2 cm. Stamens: anthers 6 mm, oblong. Fruits 2–3 by 1.5 cm, ellipsoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Fagraea crenulata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 203. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Small tree or shrub, sometimes epiphytic, bark unknown, slash-mark unknown; twigs greyish-brown, terete. Leaves: petiole 1.5–3 cm, sub-terete to slightly ridged; lamina obovate to oblong, elliptic, lamina 7.5–20 by 3–9.5 cm; base cuneate, apex acuminate or obtuse to rounded with a short triangular acumen, coriaceous; midrib distinctly raised on upper surface, rounded to keeled below, secondary veins invisible on both surfaces. Stipules 1–3 mm high in leaf axils. Inflorescence terminal, (1–)2–4 flowered; peduncle unknown; pedicels 1.2–2.7 cm, stout. Calyx 2.4–2.7 cm, campanulate in flower, distinctively conical/funnel-shaped in fruit; lobes 10–14 mm, at least as broad as long. Corolla 7.5–8.2 cm, yellow, broadly funnel-shaped; tube 4.5–4.7 mm, lobes 3–3.5 cm, oblong. Stamens not exserted, filaments 3.4–3.6 cm, anthers 8–9 mm, oblong. Ovary and style ca 6 cm, stigma 2.5–3 mm across, peltate. Fruit colour unknown, 4–4.5 cm diam., globose. Seeds 2.4–3 mm, oblong ellipsoid or ovoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Fagraea curtisii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 205. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree 8–30 m, bark brown, deeply fissured, slash-mark yellowish-white; twigs greyish brown, ± terete. Leaves: petiole 0.7–2 cm, slender, terete, without auricles; lamina usually elliptic, less commonly oblong to ovate to obovate to oblanceolate, 7–1 1 by 3–4.2 cm; base acute to attenuate; apex acute, acuminate or caudate (acumen 0.2–1 cm); thinly coriaceous; main vein slightly raised above, prominently keeled or ridged below; secondary veins 5–9 pairs, barely visible and slightly sunken or invisible above, visible below. Stipules 1–2 mm high in leaf axils. Inflorescence 4–12 cm, axils of the uppermost leaves, lax to dense, 3-many flowered; peduncle 2–6.5 cm; pedicels 3–6 mm. Calyx 1.7–3 mm, campanulate; lobes 0.7–2 mm, apex rounded, spreading in fruit. Corolla 1.2–2 cm, creamy white turning salmon coloured or dull-yellow; tube 0.65–1.2 cm, narrowly funnel-shaped; lobes 5.5–8 mm, oblong. Stamens exserted well beyond the corolla, filaments 1.4–2.2 cm, anthers 1.5–2 mm, oblong to elliptic. Ovary and style 1.7–2.4 cm, stigma 0.7–1 mm, capitate or obconical, occasionally faintly bi-lobed. Fruit 4.5–8 mm, globose, green turning orange or red. Seeds 1–2 mm, roughly angled.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Fagraea fragrans. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 198. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Small tree to 10 m, more rarely straggling climber; bark pale brown, fissured, slash-mark white; twigs brown, terete. Leaves: petiole 0.8–2.5 cm, sub-terete, without auricles; lamina elliptic, oblong, obovate-oblanceolate, ovate-lanceolate, 11–25 by 5–15 cm; base cuneate to subtruncate; apex acuminate or obtuse to rounded with an acumen to 1.5 cm; thickly or thinly coriaceous; midrib slightly raised to sunken above, prominently rounded below; secondary veins 4–8 pairs, visible or more rarely invisible above, prominent below. Stipules united to form an ochrea 1–2 mm high. Inflorescence terminal, to 16 cm, few to many flowered, laxly branched forming a tight head; peduncle 2–8.5 cm; pedicels 2–5 mm. Calyx 5–7 mm, campanulate; lobes 3–5 mm, constricted, becoming spreading in fruit. Corolla 2.1–3.5 cm, creamy-white to pale orange or dull yellow; tube 1.5–2 cm, funnel-shaped; lobes 5.5–10 mm, oblong. Stamens barely exserted beyond the corolla, filaments 1.4–1.8 cm, attached in the upper half of corolla tube, anthers 3–4.5 mm, oblong. Ovary and style 2.1–3.2 cm; stigma 1.3–2 mm, capitate, obconical or peltate, faintly bi-lobed. Fruit green (turning red?) ca 1–1.8 cm diam., globose-ellipsoid. Seeds 0.7–1.7 mm, roughly angled.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Fagraea racemosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 199. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Epiphytic, climbing shrub. Leaves: petiole 1.5–3 cm without auricles; lamina oblong, 6–20 by 3–10 cm; base narrowed, apex acute to long-acuminate (acumen to 1.5 cm); slightly coriaceous; main vein raised above, stoutly rounded below; secondary veins ± invisible on both surfaces. Stipules 3 mm high in leaf axils. Inflorescence few flowered; pedicels very short. Calyx 0.5–1 cm; lobes 0.2–0.5 cm long. Corolla: tube 8–9 cm, narrowly cylindrical and very slender; lobes ca 1.7 cm. Stamens ; anthers 4 mm, oblong. Fruit 2.5–3 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Fagraea tubulosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 203. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stem much branched, terete. Leaves: petiole 1–1.5 cm; lamina lanceolate to ovate, 3–13 by 1.5–3.5 cm; apex acute; base decurrent, 4–10 secondary veins. Inflorescence lax, 3–12 cm; bracteoles 1–2 mm, lanceolate. Flowers 4-merous, with long slender pedicels 5–15 mm. Calyx ca 0.5–1 mm. Corolla ca 5 mm, yellow or orange, divided virtually to base; tube usually almost absent, < 1 mm; lobes thick, fleshy, strongly coherent in bud, ca 4 mm, apiculate. Stamens with minute, scarcely evident filaments, attached towards base of corolla tube; anthers cohering, 3 mm oblong. Ovary with 1 style, together ca 0.75–1.5 mm. Fruit ca 1 cm, red. Seeds 1–2, ca 7 by 6 mm, patelliform.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Gardneria ovata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 206. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems much branched, terete. Leaves: petiole 1–1.5 cm; lamina ovate-lanceolate, 5–14 by 2–5 cm; apex long acuminate; bas rounded to decurrent, 6–12 secondary veins. Inflorescence compact, 3–12 cm, glabrous; bracteoles 1–2 mm, lanceolate, ciliate. Flowers with long slender pedicels to 6 mm. Calyx ca 0.5–1 mm, ciliate. Corolla ca 15 mm, yellow or orange; tube ca 7 mm, red-spotted inside; lobes reflexed, ca 7 mm, usually acute sometimes apiculate or rounded. Stamens exserted beyond the corolla tube, filaments ca 1 cm, attached at base of corolla tube; anthers 2 mm, oblong. Ovary with 1 style, together ca 8–12 mm. Fruit ca 1.5 cm, with 8–10 seeds per cell. Seeds flattened, ca 4 mm, winged, often strongly laciniate, centre minutely hairy.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Gelsemium elegans. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 206. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Large woody climber; stem up to 30 cm diam; tendrils stiff, woody, hook-like from the leaf-axils. Leaves glabrous, lanceolate to obovate with serrate and crenulate margin, shining above, apex rounded, caudate; 4.5–16 by 1.5–6 cm; petioles 5–15 mm. Flowers fragrant, up to 10 in axillary fascicles, shortly pedicellate; pedicels articulate; bracteoles membranous, appressed to the calyx. Sepals ovate obtuse, 2–4 mm. Petals yellow, lanceolate-obovate, 6–8 mm., short-clawed. Stamens dark yellow, joined at base in a low cup. Ovary ovoid to spherical; style and stigma dark yellow, stigma knop-shaped. Drupe red, ovoid, 5–7 mm long. Seeds 2–4 mm, ovoid, aril short.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Indorouchera griffithiana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 187. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree 7–15(–40) m; buttresses present or not, up to 1.5 m. Leaves: petiole 2–3 mm long; lamina glabrous, lanceolate to elliptic or obovate, 7–20 by 2–7 cm, at base tapering towards the petiole, apex rounded to acute, margin finely and distantly serrate and crenulate, secondary nerves faint, particularly on upper surface. Inflorescence lateral, cymose, peduncles 5–15 cm, glabrous; pedicels thin, 1.5–2 cm. Sepals triangular, joined basally, green and persistent in fruit, ca 2 mm. Petals greenish-yellow, broadly obovate also persistent in fruit. Stamens 20, persistent, filaments filiform, ca 15 mm long, anthers minute, 0.5 mm. Style 1. Disc orange. Capsule green, conical, striate, sticky to the touch, 14–17 mm long, 5–6 mm broad at base. Seeds 10 by 2 mm, orange with a white 3-lobed aril.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Ixonanthes icosandra. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 190. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree up to 30 m, often with buttresses. Leaves: petiole 1.5–2 cm; lamina elliptic-oblong, base tapering, apex obtuse, 6–15 by 4–7 cm. Inflorescence densely flowered. Peduncle 4–9 cm; pedicels ca 5 mm; bracts minute. Sepals elliptic-orbicular, ca 1 mm with a hyaline marginal band, persistent, enlarging and becoming fleshy in fruit. Petals creamy coloured, elliptic-orbicular, twice as long as sepals, also enlarging in fruit. Filaments up to 15 mm; anthers ca 1 mm. Style up to 2.5 mm. Capsule ellipsoid to subspherical; valves apically bifid. Seeds ca 10 by 4 mm
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Ixonanthes petiolaris. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 3, 1997. Pg. 190. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Buttressed tree up to 40 m; buttresses up to 5 m, steep. Leaves: petiole 1–2 cm with slightly swollen base; lamina stiffly coriaceous, shining, glabrous, ovate elliptic, base cuneate, apex rounded, 8–13 by 4–5 cm; margin always entire; secondary and tertiary nerves distinct on both sides. Inflorescence lateral and terminal cymes. Peduncle 5–7 cm; pedicels stout, 5–7 mm. Calyx segments light green, broadly triangular, obtuse, 3–5 mm. Petals triangular, 6–7 mm as the calyx persistent in fruit; disc orange. Stamens 8–12, persistent; filaments filiform, 2.5–3 cm; anthers minute, 0.5 mm. Capsule oblong, woody, not sticky to the touch, 3–4.5 cm long. Seeds compressed, oblong angular, winged in lower half, 20 by 5–10 mm.

description: Scandent shrub or woody climber up to 10 m or more, with dark brownish, glabrous and slender branches. Leaves elliptic to ovate-elliptic, acute to acuminate (or caudate) at apex, cuneate to obtuse at base, (3.5–)5–8(–10) by (1.5–)2–3(–4) cm, coriaceous, glabrous, slightly glossy above, dull or reddish beneath; petiole 3–6 mm long, glabrous; bracts subopposite. Inflorescence (3–)4–6(–12)-flowered; peduncle (ca 1.5) 3–4 cm long; bracts ovate to elliptic, truncate to rounded at base, obtuse to acute (-mucronate) at apex, 2–4.5 cm long, 1–2 cm broad, creamy white, membranaceous, glabrous, opposite to subopposite at the middle of the peduncle, or slightly below; bracteoles narrowly linear, 0.3–1 cm long, caduceus. Flowers reddish. Calyx-tube tapering to each end, 5–13 mm long, white and villous or sometimes glabrous within; calyx-lobes 6–9 by 1.5–2.5 mm, glabrous, reflexed. Petals club-shaped, 3.5–6 mm long, fleshy, exserted, sometimes with a minute annulus at the base. Stamens in one row below the petals; antisepalous filaments 6.5–9 mm long, altenisepalous ones 4–8 mm long; anthers ± 1 mm long; connective basally slightly inflated. Ovary 3–4 mm long, sericeous; style 8–11 mm long; sericeous at the base; stigma mammiform, ca 1 mm in diam., level with or exserted above the anthers; disc ± 0.5 mm high. Fruit ovoid, 8–12 mm long, 4–8 mm in diam, sericeous, surrounded by the clefted, more or less persistent calyx-tube.

description: Woody climber up to 10(–24) m, shrub or tree up to 7 m; branches slender. Leaves narrowly to broadly elliptic or ovate, obtuse and mucronate or acute, sometimes truncate at the apex, cuneate to rounded at the base, 1.5–4.5(–6) by 1–2(–3.5) cm wide, coriaceous, glabrous; petiole 2–3 mm long. Inflorescence (1–)2–5-flowered; peduncle 4–10 mm long; bracts 2, opposite or alternate, ovate or ovate-oblong, obtuse or truncate at the apex, obtuse or subcordate at the base, 2–4 by 1–2 cm wide, white, membranaceous, glabrous; single bracteole at the top of the peduncle, linear, 5–10 mm long, sometimes caducous or missing. Flowers green or greenish white. Calyx-tube 10–15 mm long, glabrous or slightly pubescent inside; calyx-lobes elliptic, 3–10 by 1–3 mm, glabrous, spreading. Petals narrowly club-shaped, 5–7 mm long, fleshy. Stamens 6–10 mm long, exserted; anthers 0.5–1 mm long, connective basally inflated, not protruding over the pollen-sacks. Ovary 3–7 mm long, sericeous; style 12–18 mm long, usually glabrous; stigma capitate; disc ring-shaped, ± 0.5 mm high. Fruit ellipsoid, 12–14 mm long, 6–7 mm in diameter, surrounded by the persistent calyx-tube.

description: Erect, straggling or climbing shrub up to 4 m high, stems slender, reddish-brown, glabrous. Leaves elliptic to obovate, obtuse, often mucronate at apex, cuneate at base, (2–)2.5–3.4(–4.1) by (0.8–)1.2–1.8(–2.2) cm, coriaceous, glabrous, darker above, sometimes somewhat glaucous; petiole 1–2.5 mm long, glabrous. Inflorescence umbelliform, terminal, 2–4(–6)-flowered; peduncle 1.5–3 cm long; bracts foliaceous, elliptic to ovate, acute and mucronate at the apex, obtuse at base, 20–32 by 12–22 mm, yellowish to whitish, membranous, glabrous; bracteoles linear, 1–4 mm long, glabrous. Flowers yellowish green or pale yellow. Calyx-tube 8–10 mm long, glabrous, usually persistent and accrescent; calyx-lobes 3.5–4.5 by 1.5–2 mm, glabrous, erect. Petals 3–3.5 mm long, fleshy, reddish. Stamens of upper antisepalous row with filaments 0.8–1 mm long, inserted just below the petals; anthers 0.8 mm long, exserted, lower alternisepalous row with filaments 0.5 mm long and anthers 0.8–1 mm long, inserted slightly lower than the antisepalous ones, included; connective not basally inflated but reaching over the pollensacs. Ovary elliptic, 2–3 mm long, densely sericeous; style filiform, 6–8 mm long, glabrous; stigma capitate, exserted above the petals; disc 0.5 mm. Fruit ellipsoid-ovoid, ± 10 mm long, 5–7 mm in diam., surrounded by the usually persistent calyx-tube.

description: Annual or biennial, erect herb; stems erect, solitary up to 1 m, rarely taller. Leaves linear or linear-lanceolate, 10–50 by 2–5 mm, acute, 3-nerved. Pedicels erect. Sepals broadly elliptic-ovate, acuminate, eglandular, 5–10 mm; margins ciliate or not. Petals blue, 10–15 mm. Styles free; stigmas linear-clavate. Capsule spherical, 7–10 mm. Seeds compressed, brown; testa slimy when moistened.

description: Differs from subsp. erophila in its leaves with minute peltate scales on the upper surface, its larger corolla of 5–6.7 mm, with rounded to sub-orbicular lobes, 2.2–4.1 mm, and its stamens which are attached in the bottom ⅓rd of the corolla tube.

description: Herb 3–20 cm; stem branched or not, glabrous or minutely hirsute in lower part, conspicuously 4-ribbed. Leaves lanceolate to narrowly ovate, 1.5–4.4 by 0.6–1.4 mm; apex acute; glabrous; uninerved. Flowers solitary in leaf axils; pedicels 2–11 mm long, postulate. Calyx 2–2.3 mm, campanulate to conical; lobes 0.9–1.2 mm, triangular, sometimes tipped by 1–2 hairs. Corolla 2.5–4 mm, campanulate, thinly hirsute in mouth; lobes 1–1.5 mm, rounded, mucronulate. Stamens with filaments 0.8–0.9 mm, attached below centre of corolla tube; anthers 0.4–0.5 mm, oblong, glabrous. Ovary and style 1.5–2 mm high, styles connate for half their length; stigma capitate to truncate. Fruit 2–3 mm high, styles connate at the tips in mature fruit. Seeds 0.2 mm, angled, coarsely reticulate.

description: Herb to 35 cm; stem to 6 cm, unbranched or branching freely mainly from near base, glabrous to densely hirsute especially at base, smooth or finely fluted. Leaves in pairs along stem (often only along the basal few centimeters), linear lanceolate to narrowly ovate; 2–16 by 0.5–4.5 mm; apex blunt to acute; uninerved or more rarely trinerved, glabrous to hirsute along margin and/or midrib. Inflorescence terminal, to 33 cm, umbellate-paniculate, lax, 1-many flowered; peduncles glabrous, branched, generally with 1–2(–3) pairs of leaf-like bracteoles to 5.5 mm (smaller bracteoles subtend the pedicels and inflorescence branches). Flowers white to yellow with orange dots or streaks on corolla tube. Calyx 2.5–3.5 mm, conical to campanulate; lobes 1–2 mm, triangular, glabrous or hirsute along margin. Corolla 5–9 mm, campanulate, sparsely hirsute in the mouth; lobes 0.8–2.2 mm, rounded. Stamens with filaments 2–2.8 mm, attached in bottom third of corolla tube; anthers 0.5–0.8 mm, oblong, glabrous. Ovary and style 3.3–4.5 mm high, styles connate for ½ to ⅔rds of their length; stigma bilobed. Fruit 4–6 mm high, styles connate for ½ to ¾ of length in mature fruit. Seeds 0.3–0.4 mm, angular ellipsoid, papillose.

description: Herb, 11–45(–75) cm; stem usually branched, glabrous, conspicuously quadrangular or 4-ribbed at base, narrowly 4-winged above. Leaves narrowly ovate, 1.2–8 by 0.5–2.5 cm; apex acute; ciliate; base decurrent, 4–10 secondary veins. Petiole channelled, glabrous, ciliate or squamulose at base. Bracteoles paired, ca 1.5 mm. Flowers usually in long drepanoid cymes; pedicels < 1 mm or absent. Calyx ca 1.2 mm, obconical; lobes ca 1.2 mm; margin ciliolate. Corolla ca 1.5 mm, white, occasionally lilac, campanulate, thinly hirsute in mouth; corolla lobes ca 0.5 mm, minutely papillose on margin. Stamens with filaments ca 0.25 mm, attached towards base of corolla tube; anthers 0.3 mm, oblong, tops often reaching base of corolla lobes. Ovary two-lobed with 2 styles 0.3–0.4 mm; stigmas capitate to truncate. Fruit 2-horned, 2 by 3 mm, horns connate or sometimes divergent. Seeds ellipsoid, one side deeply channeled, 0.5 by 0.2 mm, smooth, glossy, white to dark brown.

description: Erect or prostrate shrub up to 1 m, usually lower; branches terete. Leaves glabrous, petiole 5–10 mm long; lamina obovate or lanceolate, base tapering towards the petiole, apex rounded or acute, sometimes mucronate, 2–7 by 1–3 cm. Flowers axillary or terminal, solitary or clustered, in few-flowered cymes. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, acute, 10–15 mm. Petals clawed, broadly obovate, 15–30 mm long. Ovary glabrous, 4–5-loculate, styles 3–5, glabrous, as long as ovary. Capsule ovoid, surrounded by the persistent calyx and shorter than this.

description: Annual with a vertical tap-root. Stems erect, to 40 cm, branched above, with a distinct all-over indumentum of simple spreading hairs. Leaves distributed over stem, simple to pinnati-partite, oblong to oblong-obovate in outline; indumentum on both surfaces as on stem, denser on abaxial surface; margin irregularly serrate-dentate; petiole on lowermost leaves to ca 2 cm, decreasing above with the upper leaves auriculate. Racemes bracteates, upper bracts linear-oblong, shorter than pedicels. Petals pale yellow, 2–5 mm. Fruiting pedicels 4–5 mm, spreading-erect, scarcely thickened. Siliqua straight or slightly curved, 10–11 by 1.2 mm. Seeds arranged in 2 rows in each loculus, ca 0.6 by 0.5 mm, quadrate-angular, very finely colliculate.

description: Annual with a vertical tap-root. Stems branched from base, 10–30 cm, erect-ascending, completely glabrous or with very few hairs, mostly confined to base of stem. Leaves forming basal rosettes or not and scattered over stem, simple or pinnatipartite with 1–2 small basal lobes; lamina ovate or ovate-oblong, ca 3.5 by 1.5–3 cm, base cuneate, margin crenulate-serrulate, with the serrulations sometimes tipped with 1 or 2 minute hairs; petiole on basal leaves to ca 5 cm, those on upper leaves gradually smaller in size. Racemes ebracteate. Petals usually absent. Fruiting pedicels 3–4 mm, ± spreading, somewhat thickened. Siliqua straight, 20–27 by 0.7–1.1 mm, ± horizontally spreading. Seeds arranged in a single row, ca 0.8 by 0.7 mm, quadrate-angular, reddish-brown, very finely colliculate.

description: Glabrous perennial. Stems sturdy, procumbent at base then ascending, hollow, up to ca 100 cm. often rooting at lower nodes. Leaves dark green, clearly pinnate with 3–5 pairs of obovate-orbicular leaflets; upper leaves with short amplexicaul auricles. Petals white, ca 5 by 2 mm. Fruiting pedicels spreading, deflexed or ascending, ca 10 mm. Siliqua straight or curved, ca 15 by 2 mm. Seeds clearly arranged in 2 rows in each loculus; seeds reddish-brown, finely reticulate.

description: Scrambling shrub, large woody climber or rarely small tree; twigs grey-green to brown to blackish-brown, without lenticels, glabrous to densely pubescent, terete to slightly quadrangular; axillary spines often present; tendrils solitary, pubescent. Leaves: petiole 1–10 mm, glabrous to pubescent; lamina rhomboid to suborbicular, lanceolate to ovate, 1.5–11 by 1–5.8 cm; base acute to truncate to sub-cordate, rarely cuneate; apex blunt to acute, occasionally mucronulate; chartaceous to thinly coriaceous, both surfaces glabrous or pubescent along midrib and base of veins, lower surface rarely pubescent throughout; 3–5-plinerved, midrib sunken above, clearly protruding, rounded to ridged below. Stipules a protruding line, glabrous to densely pubescent. Inflorescence 5–20 mm, axillary or terminal, lax to dense, glabrous to densely tomentose, many-flowered, sub-sessile or on a peduncle to 9 mm; pedicels absent or to 2.5 mm. Calyx 0.9–1.7 mm; sepals ovate to orbicular, outside glabrous to tomentose, inside glabrous. Corolla 2.3–3.6 mm, green to white; tube 2-times as long as lobes; outside glabrous, tomentose or papillose; inside usually with a ring of short bristle-like hairs at mouth of corolla tube, otherwise glabrous; lobes evenly thickened. Stamens inserted mid-way on corolla tube, filaments 0.2–0.6 mm; anthers 0.6–0.9 mm, ovate, barbate, usually minutely apiculate. Ovary and style 1.5–2.4 mm, glabrous, stigma capitate and papillose. Fruit 0.5–1.5 cm diam., green turning orange or red when ripe, globose or ovoid, thin-walled, smooth, glabrous, with 1–2 seeds. Seeds 4–6 mm, 3 mm thick, sub-orbicular, glabrous.

description: Woody climber; twigs brown without lenticels, densely pubescent, terete; spines absent; tendrils present, paired, tomentose. Leaves: petiole 2–4 mm, densely tomentose; lamina lanceolate to narrowly ovate, 6–10 by 2–4 cm; base rounded to sub-cordate; apex acuminate; sub-coriaceous, minutely hirsute along the lower midrib, otherwise glabrous; 3-plinerved, midrib sunken above, rounded below. Stipules a raised line, densely tomentose. Inflorescence 3–4 cm, terminal and axillary, densely pubescent, dense and many flowered; pedicels ca 2 mm. Calyx 1 mm long, sepals ovate. Corolla 12 mm, white, tube ca thrice as long as lobes; outside papillose; inside completely glabrous; lobes papillose and slightly thickened. Stamens with filaments 0.5 mm; anthers sub-basifixed, 1.75 mm, oblong, glabrous, not apiculate. Ovary and style 9 mm, style sparsely woolly, ovary glabrous; stigma capitate. Fruit 1.5–3 cm diam., colour unknown, globose, thin walled, with 2–7 seeds. Seeds 1.5–2 cm, discoid.

description: Climber, twigs yellowish-brown with small yellowish Ienticels; glabrous to sub-glabrous, terete; spines absent; tendrils paired, puberulent when young, becoming glabrous. Leaves: petiole 5–8 mm, glabrous to sparsely tomentose; lamina lanceolate to narrowly ovate to narrowly elliptic, 5–14 by 2.2–4.5 cm; base acute to sub-truncate; apex acute to acuminate; sub-coriaceous, glabrous; 3–5-plinerved, midrib sunken above, distinctly rounded below. Stipules a clearly raised line, glabrous. Inflorescence 2–2.5 cm, axillary, dense, sparsely tomentose, many-flowered peduncle absent, branching from the base; pedicels to 2.5 mm. Stamens with filaments 1.8–2.5 mm; anthers, 1.1–1.5 mm, oblong, glabrous minutely apiculate. Ovary and style 4.3–5.2 mm, basal part of style and upper part of ovary shortly woolly; stigma capitate. description: Large woody climber; twigs grey or brown, with or without very fine dense lenticels, glabrous, terete; spines absent; tendrils solitary, glabrous. Leaves: petiole 7–10 mm, glabrous; lamina ovate, oblong-ovate, elliptic or oblong-elliptic, 9–16 by 47 cm; base acute to rounded; apex acuminate to caudate or rarely acute; coriaceous, glabrous; 3-plinerved, midrib sunken above, keeled below. Corolla 1.1–1.7 cm long, white or green; tube 3-times as long as lobes; outside papillose; inside with some scattered woolly hairs in lower half of tube; lobes thickened and papillose at the tips. description: Climber, twigs glabrous, brown or grey with or without minute lenticels, terete; spines absent; tendrils unknown. Stamens with filaments 1–1.5 mm; anthers 1.2–2 mm, oblong, bearded, apiculate. Ovary and style 5–6.7 mm, ovary and lower part of style long woolly; stigma capitate. Fruit and seeds unknown.

description: Small tree or scandent shrub; trunk and older branches with scattered stout spines; twigs silvery-grey, roughened by many grey lenticels, sparsely pubescent when young, soon glabrous, terete; axillary spines and tendrils absent. Leaves: petiole 2–4 mm, glabrous or with a thin line of hairs; lamina ovate, elliptic or suborbicular, 2.1–7 by 1.3–4.8 mm; base cuneate to truncate; apex blunt to rounded, sometimes emarginate; chartaceous, glabrous, usually somewhat granular on lower surface; 3(5)-plinerved, midrib slightly raised to sunken above, rounded to barely keeled below. Stipules an inconspicious line, glabrous. Inflorescence 1.9–3.5 cm, terminal, often on the end of short side shoots, lax, minutely and densely tomentose, few-flowered; peduncle 6–12 mm; pedicels absent or less than 3 mm. Corolla 10.3–13.5 mm, pale green; tube 2–3-times as long as lobes; outside papillose; inside sparsely woolly just below centre of corolla tube; lobes papillose and slightly thickened. Stamens with filaments 0.5–0.8 mm; anthers 1.2–1.9 cm, oblong, glabrous, minutely apiculate. Ovary and style 1–1.2 cm, glabrous, stigma truncate. description: Climber, twigs greyish with or without lenticels; glabrous, ± terete; spines absent; tendrils paired, glabrous. Leaves: petiole 3–10 mm, glabrous; lamina lanceolate to narrowly ovate or elliptic, 4.5–14 by 2.1–8.5 cm; base broadly cuneate to rounded; apex blunt, acute or acuminate, rarely caudate; chartaceous, glabrous; 3–5-plinerved, midrib slightly raised or flat above, rounded below. Stipules a raised line, glabrous. Inflorescence 2–10 cm, axillary and/or terminal, lax, rarely dense, sparsely to densely tomentose, many-flowered; peduncle 1–20 mm; pedicels 2.5 mm. Calyx 0.7–1.2 mm; sepals ovate to suborbicular, outside glabrous to tomentose, inside glabrous. Stamens with filaments 0.8–1.1 mm; anthers 0.8–1.2 mm, oblong or narrowly ovate, barbate, sometimes minutely apiculate. Ovary and style 3–4.8 mm, upper part of ovary and most of style sparsely to densely pubescent; stigma capitate. Fruit 1.2–2 cm diam., green turning red or purple, roughly globose, thin walled, smooth or minutely punctate, glabrous, with 1–4(–8) seeds. Seeds 1–1.5 cm, lenticular, glabrous.

description: Woody climber; twigs brownish grey with few scattered lenticels, glabrous, terete to sub-quadrangular, finely fluted. Leaves: petiole 3–7 mm, sparsely tomentose; lamina lanceolate to ovate to sub-orbicular, oblong to oblong-ovate, elliptic, oblong-elliptic, 5.2–15.9 by 2–6.5 cm; base cuneate to rounded; apex acuminate to caudate; chartaceous, glabrous; 3–5-plinerved, midrib slightly sunken to flat above, rounded below. Stipules a raised line with a pronounced line of hairs. Inflorescence 3.5–6 cm, terminal, dense, glabrous to finely pubescent, many-flowered; peduncle to 3 cm; pedicels to 3 mm. Calyx 0.7–1 mm; sepals ovate to oblong, outside tomentose, inside glabrous. Corolla 1.1–1.5 cm, greenish; tube more than five times as long as lobes; outside glabrous; inside densely woolly in mouth, few scattered hairs in upper ¾ of tube; lobes minutely papillose, very slightly thickened at tips. Stamens with filaments 0.2–0.3 mm; anthers, 0.8–1 mm, oblong, glabrous, not apiculate. Ovary and style 10–13.5 mm, bottom ⅔ rds of style pubescent, ovary glabrous; stigma sub-capitate. description: Tree to 15 m; twigs yellowish grey without lenticeIs; glabrous, ± terete; axillary spines sometimes present; tendrils absent. Leaves: petiole 5–17 mm, glabrous or sparsely tomentose; lamina elliptic, broadly ovate, orbicular, 4.9–15 by 2 3–12 cm; base acute to rounded to subcordate, apex blunt to acuminate, often mucronulate, thinly chartaceous, glabrous or sometimes sparsely tomentose along the lower nerves; 3–5-plinerved, midrib slightly sunken to flat above, rounded below. Inflorescence 3–5.5 cm terminal or on ends of short side-branches, fairly lax to dense, tomentose, many flowered; peduncle 1–3 cm; pedicels < 2.5 mm. Calyx 1.5–2.2mm; sepals narrowly ovate to lanceolate, outside sparsely tomentose to glabrous, inside glabrous. Corolla 9.4–13.6 mm, green to white; tube ca 3-times as long as lobes; outside glabrous to finely papillose, inside sparsely woolly in lower part of tube; lobes densely papillose; lobes thickened at the tip. Stamens sessile; anthers 1.5–2 mm, oblong, glabrous, minutely apiculate or not. Ovary and style 8.1–13 mm, glabrous, stigma capitate, papillose. Fruit 5–8 cm diam., red to orange when ripe, globose, thick-walled, scabrous, glabrous, with 4–15 seeds. Seeds 1.5–2.2 cm, 5–15 mm thick, irregularly ellipsoid, surface sericeous.

description: Tree 5–25 m; twigs yellowish grey without lenticels, glabrous, terete; spines sometimes present; tendrils absent. Leaves: petiole 5–11 mm, glabrous; lamina elliptic, broadly ovate, sub-orbicular, base sub-acute to rounded to sub-truncate, 4–10.5 by 3–8.6 cm; base rounded to sub-cordate; apex blunt to sub-acuminate, often mucronulate; thinly chartaceous, glabrous; 3–5-plinerved, midrib slightly raised or flat above, rounded below. Inflorescence 2.5–5.5 cm, terminal, generally on short axillary branches, fairly lax, tomentose, many-flowered; peduncle 3 cm; pedicels < 2 mm. Calyx 0.5–1.5 mm; sepals ovate, outside tomentose, inside glabrous. Corolla 8.3–13 mm, green to white; tube ca 3-times as long as lobes; outside finely papillose; inside sparsely woolly in lower part of corolla tube, lobes densely papillose; lobes thickened at the tip. Stamens sessile; anthers 1.5–1.8 mm, oblong, glabrous, minutely apiculate or not. Ovary and style 8.4–12 mm, glabrous or sometimes the style sparsely woolly about the middle, stigma capitate and papillose. Fruit 2.5–4 cm diam., orange to red when ripe, globose, thick-walled, scabrous, glabrous, with 1–4 seeds. Seeds 21–22 mm, < 4 mm thick, discoid, surface sericeous.

description: Woody climber, twigs reddish-brown with prominent whitish lenticels, glabrous, slightly quadrangular in section especially at nodes; axillary spines absent; tendrils paired, glabrous. Leaves: petiole 0.5–1 cm, glabrous; lamina elliptic, ovate to lanceolate, 3.8–9 by 2–4.8 cm; base cuneate to rounded; apex acute to acuminate or rarely rounded, chartaceous, glabrous; 3-plinerved, midrib slightly sunken above, clearly rounded below. Stipules a raised line, glabrous. Inflorescence 1.5–2.5 cm, axillary, lax, tomentose, few to many-flowered; peduncle absent or to 5 mm; pedicels to 1 cm. Calyx to 1 mm, with ovate sepals, outside sparsely tomentose, inside glabrous. Corolla to 5 mm, white; tube extremely reduced; outside glabrous; inside with long woolly hairs in upper part of tube and base of lobes, lobes thickened and densely papillose at tips. Stamens inserted at base of corolla tube, filaments to 3 mm; anthers 1 mm, oblong, glabrous, not apiculate. Ovary and style lower ⅔ rds woolly, stigma truncate. Fruit 25 mm or more diam., yellowish-green to purple (?), globose, thin-walled, punctate, minutely woolly near the fruit tip, usually with two seeds. Seeds 1–1.1 by 0.8–1 cm, lenticular, glabrous.

description: Woody climber or clambering shrub; twigs orangey-brown to grey with or without lenticels, glabrous, terete; spines present on younger branches; tendrils, solitary, glabrous. Leaves: petiole 5–12 mm, glabrous: lamina ovate, elliptic or obovate, 5–10.3 by 4–6.8 cm; base acute to rounded to truncate; apex acute to acuminate; chartaceous, glabrous on both surfaces; 3-plinerved, midrib flat or slightly sunken above, strongly projecting and ribbed below. Stipules an inconspicuous line, glabrous. Inflorescence to 3 cm, terminal, tomentose; pedicels to 3 mm. Calyx 1–1.75 mm, sepals lanceolate. Corolla 8–10 mm; tube ca 2-times as long as lobes, outside finely papillose; inside sparsely hairy in bottom half of tube; lobes very slightly thickened, densely papillose at tips. Stamens sessile; anthers 1.5–1.75 mm, oblong-elliptic, glabrous, not apiculate. Ovary and style 7.5–9.5 mm, glabrous; stigma subcapitate. Fruit 2–4.5 cm diam., a distinctive orange colour when dry, globose, thin-walled, with 1–4 seeds. Seeds subglobular and small (9–11 mm) to discoid and larger (2–2.2 cm), 4 mm thick, sericeous.

description: Large liane; twigs yellowish grey with or without small yellowish lenticels, densely pubescent, terete; spines absent; tendrils paired, tomentose. Leaves: petiole 6–8 mm, densely tomentose; lamina narrowly ovate or narrowly oblong to oblong; lamina 4.1–9.4 by 2.3–4.5 cm; base rounded to truncate; apex acute to rounded, apiculate, thickly chartaceous, tomentose along the lower nerves, otherwise glabrous; 3-plinerved, midrib slightly sunken above, rounded below. Stipules a raised line, glabrous. Inflorescence terminal and axillary. Flowers unknown. Fruit 2.2–2.3 by 1.7–1.8 cm diam., green to yellow, ellipsoid, thin walled with a thin translucent outer coat which is distinctively crinkled and papery when dry, glabrous, with 1 seed. Seeds 1.5–2 cm, 8 mm thick, ellipsoid, glabrous.

description: Large woody climber or tree; twigs silvery grey to brown without lenticels, glabrous, quadrangular; spines absent; tendrils paired, glabrous. Leaves: petiole 3–9 mm, glabrous; lamina lanceolate to ovate, ovate-oblong, elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 8–18 by 2.6–8 cm; base acute to subtruncate, apex acuminate to caudate, chartaceous, glabrous; 3-plinerved, midrib flat to slightly sunken above, sharply keeled below. Stipules a distinct line, glabrous. Inflorescence 1–4.5 cm, axillary, fairly lax, glabrous to sparsely tomentose, few to many-flowered; peduncle 1–7 mm; pedicels 0.5–2.5 mm. Calyx 0.8–1.1 mm; sepals narrowly ovate to ovate, outside glabrous, inside glabrous. Corolla 2.5–4 mm, green; tube about 0.5-times as long as lobes; outside glabrous; inside densely pubescent in basal part of lobes and top of tube just below them, lobes slightly thickened and densely papillose at tips. Stamens with filaments 1.2–2 mm; anthers 0.5–0.8 mm, narrowly ovate or oblong, glabrous, apiculate or not. Ovary and style 1–2.4 mm, glabrous, stigma truncate. Fruit ca 2 cm diam., red when ripe, globose, thin walled, with 1 seed. Seeds ca 1 cm, sub-globular, glabrous.

description: Woody climber; twigs light to dark brown without lenticels, densely tomentose becoming glabrous with age, terete; spines absent; tendrils unknown. Leaves: petiole 1–4 mm, densely tomentose, lamina lanceolate to narrowly elliptic, 5.2–10.3 by 2.6–3.6 mm; base acute to rounded, apex acute to acuminate, chartaceous, tomentose along upper and lower nerves when young, becoming glabrous; 3–5-plinerved, midrib slightly sunken above, rounded below. Stipules a distinct line, densely tomentose when young, glabrous when old. Inflorescence to 30 mm, terminal or axillary in upper leaf axils, fairly dense, tomentose, many-flowered; peduncle distinct, 1.2–1.9 cm; pedicels absent or to 7 mm. Calyx 0.7–0.8 mm; sepals ovate to triangular, outside and inside sparsely tomentose. Corolla 2.2–3.1 mm, colour unknown; tube slightly shorter than lobes; outside sparsely woolly; inside densely woolly on lobes; lobes not thickened. Stamens inserted in mouth of corolla-tube; filaments 0.4–0.5 mm; anthers 0.5–0.7 mm, ovate, glabrous, apiculate. Ovary and style 1.4–1.7 mm, sparsely pubescent in lower half of the style, sometimes hairs extending to very upper part of the ovary, stigma capitate. Fruit 1.7–2.3 cm diam., ellipsoid to globular, thin walled, with 1–4 seeds. Seeds 12.5–15 mm, 3.5 mm thick, ellipsoid, woolly tomentose.

description: Branches pubescent to glabrescent. Leaves elliptic or elliptic-oblong, 20–32 mm long, 6–13 mm wide, slightly to densely pubescent on both sides, sometimes glabrous below. Inflorescence terminal, spicate, pubescent. Flowers 5-merous, yellow, subsessile. Calyx-tube 8–10 mm long, pubescent; calyx-lobes 5, ovate, 1–2 mm long, pilose. Stamens 10 in two series; anthers 0.5–1 mm long. Ovary oblong, 2–4 mm long, pilose at apex; disc solitary, linear, 2–4-lobate. Fruit dry, ellipsoid, 4–5 mm long.

description: Shrub up to about 1 m high; branches slender, purplish. Branchlets slender, spreading, glabrous or sparsely pilose at apex when young. Leaves narrowly elliptic or elliptic; base and apex acute; 15–25 mm by 5–10 mm, glabrous, membraneous; petiole ± 1 mm long. Inflorescence spicate, gradually elongating up to 4 cm or even more, glabrous or very sparsely pubescent. Flowers yellow, sessile or subsessile. Calyx-tube 7.5–9 mm long, sericeo-pubescent or sparsely hairy; calyx-lobes ovate, slightly spathulate, 1–2 mm long, 0.8–1.5 mm wide, with scattered hairs. Stamens with filaments 0.2 mm; anthers 0.8–1.2 mm long. Ovary 2–3 mm long, slightly pilose at top; style 0.3 mm long; stigma 0.3 mm long; disc of one or two scales, linear, 1.2 mm long, lobed. Fruit dry, 5 by 2 mm. Seed elliptic, 3 by 1.2 mm.

description: Twiggy shrub up to 3 m; branchlets slender, brownish, glabrous or scattered puberulous, glabrescent. Leaves narrowly oblong to obovate, narrowly elliptic to elliptic, rarely ovate; base cuneate to attenuate; apex rounded or obtuse, rarely acute; 1.4–4.8(–7) by 5–1.8(–3.2) cm, glabrous or sparsely puberulous beneath, shining green on the upper surface, dull beneath, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, when dry, usually brown to reddish-brown; petiole 1–2 mm long. Inflorescence terminal or axillary, few-flowered; subsessile or pedunculate up to 3 mm. Flowers 4-merous, green or greenish yellow; pedicels 1.5–2 mm long. Calyx-tube 5–10 mm long, very sparsely pilose outside or glabrous inside, articulated below the middle; calyx-lobes oblong to ovate, obtuse, 2–3 mm long, 1–2 mm wide, sparsely pilose outside. Stamens with short filaments; anthers linear, ± 1 mm long. Ovary ellipsoid, 1.5–2 mm long, sparsely pilose or glabrous; style 0.5 mm long or obscure; stigma globose; disc of two scales, linear, sometimes truncate or crenate. Fruit fleshy, broadly ellipsoid, 4–6 by 3–4 mm, scarlet. Seed 4–5 mm long, black.

description: Shrub 0.5–4 m high or small tree; branches terete, reddish to brown, glabrous, branchlets sparsely pubescent, or glabrescent. Leaves narrowly ovate or elliptic; base acute, cuneate or rounded; apex acuminate to acute; (3–)4.2–7(–11.2) by 1.4–3(–3.9) cm, glabrous, sometimes with scattered hairs beneath, especially along the lower part of the midrib, light green to dark brown above, paler beneath when dry, membranous, rarely subcoriaceous; margins sometimes slightly recurved; nerves rather distinct above; petiole 2–3 mm long, glabrous or sparsely pubescent. Inflorescence racemose, terminal or in the uppermost axils; rachis gradually lengthening as flowers fall, up to 4 cm, peduncle short but distinct. Flowers 4-merous, yellow or yellowish-green; pedicels 0.5–1 mm long, glabrous or slightly hairy. Calyx-tube 6–10 mm long, glabrous or with scattered hairs outside; calyx-lobes narrowly ovate or ovate, 1.5–4 mm long, 1–3 mm wide, glabrous or with scattered hairs. Stamens with filaments 0.5–1 mm long, included; anthers linear, 1–2 mm long. Ovary ellipsoid, 1–2.5 mm long, glabrous or with few hairs at top; style 0.5–1 mm long; stigma globose, ± 0.5 mm long, papillate; disc of two scales, linear, 1–1.5 mm long, dentate or truncate. Fruit fleshy, ellipsoid, ca 8 by 5 mm, red.

description: Slender shrublet or shrub up to 2 m; branchlets reddish-brown, sparsely puberulous, glabrescent. Leaves narrowly ovate, elliptic; base attenuate, acute or obtuse; apex acuminate; (4.6–)7.2–10.8(–14.2) cm long, 1.6–4.2 cm wide, glabrous, sometimes sparsely puberulous on the midrib beneath, membranous to chartaceous, shining olivaceous; petiole 2–3 mm long, sparsely puberulous when young. Inflorescence terminal, umbelliform, 6–12-flowered; peduncle 4–6 mm long. Flowers 4-merous, yellow or greenish yellow; pedicels 1 m long, hairy. Calyx-tube 8–14 mm long, glabrous or with scattered hairs; calyx-lobes narrowly ovate, obtuse, 2.5–4 mm long, 1–2.5 mm wide, glabrous or with few scattered hairs. Stamens shortly filamentous; anthers linear, ± 1.5 mm long, included. Ovary ellipsoid or slightly obovoid, 2–3 mm long, hairy at apex; style 0.5 mm long; stigma globose, papillose; disc of two scales, linear, 1–1.5 mm long, sometimes lobed. Fruit fleshy, ellipsoid or ovoid, 6–8 by 5 mm, red.
